brief.goal: Diagnose exhausted std-project Case attempts and allow one approved, owner-bound replacement Case validation without platform writes during implementation.
database_write_scope: Task, Manifest, project state, Solution Design, migration 075, repository, workflow, workbench UI and mock-only tests
approved manual-review evidence and Case metadata only through the bounded maintenance operation

allowed_writes: case maximum-create-attempts schema and current Gate projection
redacted failure forensics, approved manual-review evidence, atomic replacement Case/Job creation and owner-bound workbench recovery
focused mock-only smoke tests and documentation
forbidden_actions: real monitor/resource/project writes, confirmations, creates or retries
a fourth create action on the old Case or more than one on a replacement Case
new Node, business Gate, Plan/action type or confirmation phrase
raw platform requests, payloads, responses, credentials, sensitive URLs or long identifiers in tracked files or ordinary logs
administrator impersonation of the Case owner
validation_plan: migration preserves existing Case facts and projects maximum attempts from Case truth
safe error summary preserves only validated request id and redacted bounded diagnosis
approved replacement transaction is owner-bound and idempotent
old Case becomes non-executable, replacement runs readonly first and emits at most one create action
workflow Case, conversation, runtime policy, execution plan and schema smoke tests pass with real platform writes equal to zero
stop_conditions: a clear platform diagnosis or approved review evidence is absent
any path would bypass a fresh Plan/hash/confirmation, owner isolation or verified readback
the change would persist raw sensitive platform data

result.external_dependency: 平台必须提供 Attempt 3 的明确诊断，才可由受控维护入口写入人工复盘批准证据。
